_comment: Example relay instance: one Slack channel, one Slack app per seat. Copy to instances/<name>/config.json (directory mode 700) and replace every placeholder. All IDs here are fake. trusted_humans maps Slack user ID to display name; only those users and the ledgered interactive lead can start replies. limits: daily_turns per rolling 24 h, idle_hours before agents pause, buffer_context_max unaddressed messages carried into the next addressed turn.

project._comment: Injected into every prompt. 'not' is optional: a neighbouring project the agents must not confuse with this channel.
project.name: example project
project.description: A short description of what this channel works on.

slack._comment: credentials_dir holds one slack-<seat>.env file per seat (SLACK_BOT_TOKEN=...) plus the receiver app's app_token_file (SLACK_APP_TOKEN=xapp-...). Every file is mode 600 and never committed. initial_watermark null means the first start begins now, with no backlog replay. reconcile_seconds is the history poll interval while Socket Mode is connected; poll_seconds is used while it is not.

_comment_default_mode: Seats wake only when mentioned or named at the start of a message or line; the lead seat also takes untagged requests from trusted humans. Unaddressed messages ride along as context on the next addressed turn. Set follow_conversation to wake every seat on every message (about 5x the model turns).

claude._comment: The lead seat. executable must be an absolute path (no ~ expansion). The interactive lead posts with this seat's bot through control.py lead-post.

muse._comment: model null uses the Muse CLI default.

antigravity._comment: ACP seat. executable is the absolute path to an ACP-compatible server for this seat (Gemini CLI documents `gemini --acp`; check whether your Antigravity install ships one). home is its private state dir under the instance. A model id ending in -high/-medium/-low is split into model plus thinking level when the runtime offers them separately.

_comment_posture: posture inherit (default) runs each CLI exactly as you run it interactively; the relay adds nothing. Per-seat fields shell, permission_mode, approval_policy, approval_mode, codex_mcp_allow and codex_plugin_allow apply only when a seat sets posture to locked.
_comment_yolo: Set "yolo": true on a seat whose harness the user runs without approvals; a headless run has nobody to approve, so without it actions that need approval are refused.
